data.title: About messages.
items: Do I need a WhatsApp Business number?

Only for campaigns. Automatic messages, announcements, follower updates and personal messages work without one. For campaigns, you connect a WhatsApp Business number through Meta once, and we’ll help.
Meta charges for business-started WhatsApp conversations, billed to your WhatsApp Business account at its rates.
Can I message people I imported from a spreadsheet?
Event messages, yes, for an event they’re booked on. Campaigns only go to people who opted in to hear from you on WhatsApp, so ask them first.
To campaigns, yes: replies land in your Catch inbox and you can answer while WhatsApp’s reply window is open. Announcements are one-way notifications.
Can I send email or SMS?
Not yet. Messages go by WhatsApp, in-app notification and the personal WhatsApp button.
Does Catch send messages for me?
Yes: confirmations, reminders, changes, cancellations and the thank-you go out for every booking, so guests always know where to be.
